note: The pair kg's save-excursion and with-current-buffer prelude macros are built on since sub-plan 11D Part 4, exercised directly rather than only through the macros. A non-nil argument to the capture asks for point as well as the buffer, so the restore puts point back where it was; the buffer-only spelling ((internal--excursion-capture nil)) is what with-current-buffer uses. Not meant to be called by user code -- they are internal-- names -- but real natives in their own right, so they get a case of their own.
